# Woodpecker puzzles 1 to 6 (Steinitz)

For each puzzle: paste the PGN block into **Paste a FEN or PGN**, set the title, and paste the note.

## 1. Hamppe – Steinitz, Vienna 1860

Black to move.

**Title:** 1. Hamppe – Steinitz, Vienna 1860

**Note:** Black would have been lost without this resource.

```
[FEN "r6r/1pp3k1/1b6/p2P1p2/P1N1pn2/2P2PP1/BP5P/4RR1K b - - 0 30"]
[SetUp "1"]

30. ... Rxh2+ 31. Kxh2 Rh8#
```

## 3. Steinitz – Dubois, London (6) 1862

White to move.

**Title:** 3. Steinitz – Dubois, London (6) 1862

**Note:** The bishop on d6 is pinned, and Steinitz took advantage with 14.Bxf4! exf4 15.e5, winning a piece.

```
[FEN "r2q1rk1/pppb1ppp/3b4/4p1P1/4Pn2/2N1B2P/PPPQBP2/2KR3R w - - 0 14"]
[SetUp "1"]

14. Bxf4 exf4 15. e5
```
